children: Adani Enterprises Limited (NSE:ADANIENT) is expected to contribute up to $1.45 billion in equity toward the Adani Group’s acquisition of Evos, with the remaining funding from debt. Morgan Stanley expects the company’s EBITDA to rise from ₹14,000 crore in FY26 to ₹29,900 crore by March 2029.
: Adani Enterprises is expected to contribute up to $1.45 billion in equity toward the Adani Group’s acquisition of Dutch storage operator Evos, with remaining funding from debt.
: Morgan Stanley expects Adani Enterprises’ EBITDA to rise from ₹14,000 crore in FY26 to ₹29,900 crore by March 2029, a projected 29% annual growth rate.
: Adani Enterprises rose 1% after subsidiary Kutch Copper signed an MoU with Chile’s Codelco to explore a partnership on the Kaburkaala copper project, with potential links to Adani’s Mundra smelter.
: Adani Enterprises’ subsidiary formed Adani Rovuma Chemicals in the UAE. The new firm will hold gas-to-chemicals projects.
